case1.name: Mateo C., age 24
case1.quote: With the AI Coach and daily macro-optimized meal plans, I stopped guessing. The physical and confidence transformation was unbelievable.

case2.name: Valeria M., age 23
case2.quote: I tried extreme diets for years. FitGO showed me how to eat balanced meals without starving, and the food scanner simplified everything.

item1.name: Andres G.
item1.comment: Best investment for my health. The AI nutrition coach saves me hundreds compared to private clinics, and plans fit my daily grind.

item2.name: Camila D.
item2.comment: The food scanner and voice logging are pure magic. Logging meals takes 10 seconds and my consistency hit an all-time high.

item3.name: Diego L.
item3.comment: Went from being confused about nutrition to building clean muscle mass. Leagues and streaks keep you motivated every day.

item4.name: Laura S.
item4.comment: Zero ads and complete video guides for every movement. Worth every single cent, best fitness app out there.
